title: Staged Managed Reconciliation
purpose: Defines isolated reconciliation of selected initializer-managed material onto a staged copy of an existing initialized target while preserving content outside initializer-managed authority.

normative_requirements.text: Staged managed reconciliation shall operate on an isolated staged copy or equivalent isolated staged representation of the existing target repository; the accepted target shall not be mutated while reconciliation is incomplete.
Only material identities present in the resolved legal reconciliation set may be added, modified, removed, or retargeted by this component.

Target content outside initializer-managed authority shall be preserved byte-for-byte or semantically unchanged according to its governing representation and shall not be deleted, replaced, or retargeted merely because the supplying framework lacks or differs at the same path.

For selected managed material, add, modify, remove, and retarget operations shall realize the reconciliation-target inventory definition and exact source material from the supplying framework revision, subject to applicable material-manifest operation semantics.

Initializer-managed generated or installed projections shall be reconciled consistently with the governing managed source material so the staged repository does not retain a stale managed projection after its source authority changes.

A target-local modification to initializer-managed material that cannot be proven equivalent to the accepted baseline managed state shall be surfaced as a managed-state conflict and shall not be silently overwritten; absent a separately accepted automatic conflict policy, the reconciliation shall fail or defer before destructive replacement.
The component shall preserve deterministic evidence of selected operations, conflicts, and resulting staged managed state for downstream re-anchoring and validation.
